meta.name: BuzzFeed Celeb
meta.description:
From the latest celebrity headlines to favorite
hilariously mundane happenings, BuzzFeed is here to
keep you updated on what all your favorite celebs
are up to.

Shows: Austin Butler, Nelly Furtado & Gracie Abrams Answer Fan Questions, Sarah Paulson & Sydney Sweeney Play With Puppies, Awkwafina, Bretman Rock & Sydney Sweeney Answer Fan Questions, SpongeBob & How To Train Your Dragon Cast Talk Behind the Scenes, John Boyega & Oscar Isaac Talk Star Wars
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
